decisions.reason: Given substantial investment in a central platform and prior public commitment, management will likely persist because dropping it would write off sunk costs and expose the earlier decision as a mistake.
The firm has invested in and publicly committed to this mobile software, and no clear permanent failure is evident, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it.
Although this extension may involve lower investment than the platform, it still has public commitment and no conclusive evidence of permanent failure, so management is inclined to continue it.
